opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow; must be a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Supports postdoctoral researchers with additional funding to help them achieve their full potential, including consumables, training, and other justified costs.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing key questions in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports development of novel educational resources or educational research projects in physiology.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or promote knowledge transfer and impact.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for pilot studies, new techniques, and activities that promote knowledge transfer and impact in physiology.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full or Fellow members in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Supports members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles in physiology.
